The '''warding shield''' is a {{MCW|Shield|shield}} inlaid with silver and painted with a [[Nazar]]. It carries {{G|Warding}} 1, which works from the off hand, so it adds warding on top of whatever weapon the player holds.

== Obtaining ==
=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[silver bullion]] goes in the template slot, a shield in the base slot and a Nazar in the addition slot. The shield's face shows a fixed nazar pattern (a light blue circle with a black flower on white, with a blue border), whose banner layers are hidden from the tooltip.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/warding_shield.json}}</ref> Enchantments on the original shield are kept (see [[Set bonus#Intrinsic enchantments|intrinsic enchantments]]).

== Usage ==
=== Blocking ===
The warding shield blocks like an ordinary shield and has the same {{Value|Warding Shield|durability}} durability.

=== Warding ===
Held in either hand, the shield gives {{G|Warding}} 1. Its warding is added to that of the item in the other hand, up to {{G|Warding}} 3: a [[Warding Sword]] or [[Silver Sword]] with the shield gives {{G|Warding}} 2, and a [[Nazar]] or [[Electrum Axe]] with the shield gives {{G|Warding}} 3. See [[Warding]].

=== Repairing ===
The warding shield can only be repaired with a [[Nazar]] or a {{MCW|Block of Lapis Lazuli|block of lapis lazuli}}.

== Advancements ==
Smithing the warding shield grants ''Convoymaster'' ("Affix a Nazar to an Shield inlaid with Silver in a Smithing Table") in the [[Advancements/Tutorial|Tutorial]] tab, which rewards an [[Obol]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/smith_warding_shield.json}}</ref>
